# Data Layer

All note data lives in `data/` and is generated by `dendron publish`. Never write to `data/` manually.

## Available utilities (utils/build.ts)

```ts
getNotes()                   // { notes: Record<id, NoteProps>, noteIndex: NoteProps }
getNoteBySlugPath(slug)      // look up note by string[] slug (fname.split("."))
getNotePaths()               // GetStaticPathsResult — all note slugs
getNoteBody(id)              // Promise<string> — rendered HTML
getNoteMeta(id)              // Promise<NoteProps> — note metadata
getConfig()                  // Promise<DendronConfig> — site config
getCustomHead()              // Promise<string | null> — custom <head> HTML
```

## Rules

- Only call data utilities in `getStaticProps` or `getStaticPaths` (build time), never in component render.
- Slug is always `string[]` — `note.fname.split(".")` converts dots to path segments.
- The root page uses `getNotes().noteIndex` (not a slug lookup).
- Components receive data as props; they do not call `build.ts` directly.
